items.name: OpenTelemetrySpanExt
items.summary: Utility functions to allow tracing [`Span`]s to accept and return [OpenTelemetry] [`Context`]s.

methods.name: add_event
methods.signature: fn add_event(&self, name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, attributes: Vec<KeyValue>)
methods.summary: Adds an OpenTelemetry event directly to this span, bypassing `tracing::event!`. This allows for adding events with dynamic attribute keys, similar to `set_attribute` for span attributes. Events are added with the current timestamp.

methods.name: add_event_with_timestamp
methods.signature: fn add_event_with_timestamp(&self, name: impl Into<Cow<'static, str>>, timestamp: SystemTime, attributes: Vec<KeyValue>)
methods.summary: Adds an OpenTelemetry event with a specific timestamp directly to this span. Similar to `add_event`, but allows overriding the event timestamp.

methods.name: add_link
methods.summary: Associates `self` with a given OpenTelemetry trace, using the provided followed span [`SpanContext`].

methods.name: add_link_with_attributes
methods.signature: fn add_link_with_attributes(&self, cx: SpanContext, attributes: Vec<KeyValue>)
methods.summary: Associates `self` with a given OpenTelemetry trace, using the provided followed span [`SpanContext`] and attributes.

methods.name: set_attribute
methods.signature: fn set_attribute(&self, key: impl Into<Key>, value: impl Into<Value>)
methods.summary: Sets an OpenTelemetry attribute directly for this span, bypassing `tracing`. If fields set here conflict with `tracing` fields, the `tracing` fields will supersede fields set with `set_attribute`. This allows for more than 32 fields.

methods.name: set_parent
methods.signature: fn set_parent(&self, cx: Context) -> Result<(), SetParentError>
methods.summary: Associates `self` with a given OpenTelemetry trace, using the provided parent [`Context`].

methods.name: set_status
methods.summary: Sets an OpenTelemetry status for this span. This is useful for setting the status of a span that was created by a library that does not declare the otel.status_code field of the span in advance.
